title: Data, Analytics & Lakehouse
meta_description: Data, Analytics & Lakehouse services from Dataq Software: scope, delivery pattern, platforms and committed outcomes.

blocks.x: Data, Analytics & Lakehouse is the substrate tower: pipeline modernization, lakehouse architecture on Databricks and Snowflake, streaming and event-driven decisioning, executive BI, master data and cataloging, predictive analytics, and data products that generate revenue. We build for observability and lineage from day one, because intelligence is only as defensible as the data estate beneath it.

Analytics debt is the silent killer of AI programs: duplicated pipelines, uncatalogued datasets, and batch-only refresh cycles make every model suspect. Regulators now ask where a number came from; customers ask why an app is stale; CFOs ask why the warehouse bill tripled. A governed lakehouse answers all three.
Named services for Data & Lakehouse — each page documents the build as delivered:

items: Data Engineering & Pipeline Modernization
Resilient, observable pipelines — trusted data from source to decision at SLA.
Lakehouse Architecture & Migration
Lakehouse the right way — Unity Catalog governance, cost-aware design and AI-ready foundations.
Real-Time Streaming & Event-Driven Decisioning
Decisions at event speed — sub-second pipelines from sensor, click or transaction to action.
Enterprise BI & Executive Analytics
Metrics into management — one governed semantic layer, decision cadence built in.
Master Data, Governance & Cataloging
One customer, one product, one truth — MDM and catalog discipline that regulators can read.
Advanced Risk & Predictive Analytics
Forward-looking risk on governed data — credit, insurance, operational and market models that explain themselves.
Data Monetization & Analytics Products
Turn the data estate into revenue — embedded analytics, data sharing and insight products with real P&L.

blocks.x: What a Data & Lakehouse engagement shares across services: the baseline is signed, the slice is bounded, and the gates can stop the program — that last part is a feature. In Data & Lakehouse programs the same rule applies: every artifact ships with its evidence — who signed the baseline, what the gate measured, where the number lives.
Anonymized engagements in Data, Analytics & Lakehouse: identities withheld, measurement methods available under NDA.
